stem: Which sentence from the story “Do What You Can” supports the idea that the first raindrop inspires the other raindrops?
instruction: Use “Do What You Can” to answer the following question.

options.label: H
options.text: “Yes,” said the other, “but you are only a little raindrop.” (paragraph 3)

options.label: J
options.text: “Well, if you really insist upon going, I think I will go, too.” (paragraph 6)
